```{=html}
<link rel="shortcut icon" href="data/imageTitle.png" type="image/png">
<link rel="stylesheet" href="styles.css" type="text/css">

<style>
.courses-header {
  text-align: center;
  margin: 40px 0 36px 0;
}
.courses-header h1 {
  font-size: 2em;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: #2c3e50;
  margin-bottom: 8px;
}
.courses-header p {
  color: #777;
  font-size: 1.05em;
}

.courses-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(260px, 1fr));
  gap: 24px;
  margin: 0 0 60px 0;
}

.course-card {
  background: #fff;
  border: 1px solid #dde3ea;
  border-radius: 12px;
  padding: 28px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.06);
  transition: box-shadow .2s, transform .15s;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 10px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  color: inherit !important;
}
.course-card:hover {
  box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.12);
  transform: translateY(-3px);
  text-decoration: none !important;
}

.course-card-top {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 14px;
}

.course-flag {
  font-size: 2.2em;
  line-height: 1;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}

.course-meta h3 {
  font-size: 1.1em;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #2c3e50;
  margin: 0 0 2px 0;
}
.course-meta span {
  font-size: 0.85em;
  color: #888;
}

.course-desc {
  font-size: 0.9em;
  color: #666;
  line-height: 1.55;
  margin: 0;
}

.course-tags {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  gap: 6px;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.tag {
  font-size: 0.78em;
  padding: 3px 10px;
  border-radius: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.tag-r      { background: #e8f5e9; color: #27ae60; }
.tag-eco    { background: #e3f2fd; color: #2980b9; }
.tag-fd     { background: #f3e5f5; color: #8e44ad; }
.tag-traits { background: #fff3e0; color: #e67e22; }

.course-arrow {
  text-align: right;
  font-size: 1.2em;
  color: #bbb;
  margin-top: auto;
}
</style>

<div class="courses-header">
  <h1>Courses</h1>
  <p>Select a course to access its materials. Each course is password-protected.</p>
</div>

<div class="courses-grid">

  <!-- ── Belém 2026 ── -->
  <a class="course-card" href="Rcourse.html">
    <div class="course-card-top">
      <div class="course-flag">🇧🇷</div>
      <div class="course-meta">
        <h3>Belém 2026</h3>
        <span>Universidade Federal do Pará · Brazil</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="course-desc">
      Introduction to functional ecology in R: trait data, functional diversity indices,
      RLQ &amp; fourth-corner analyses, and fish landmark morphometrics.
    </p>
    <div class="course-tags">
      <span class="tag tag-r">R</span>
      <span class="tag tag-eco">Ecology</span>
      <span class="tag tag-fd">Functional diversity</span>
      <span class="tag tag-traits">Traits</span>
    </div>
    <div class="course-arrow">→</div>
  </a>

  <!-- ── Master FBE Toulouse ── -->
  <a class="course-card" href="RcourseFBE.html">
    <div class="course-card-top">
      <div class="course-flag">🇫🇷</div>
      <div class="course-meta">
        <h3>Master FBE — Toulouse</h3>
        <span>Université de Toulouse · France</span>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="course-desc">
      Introduction to functional ecology in R: trait data handling, functional
      diversity indices, and community-level analyses for master students.
    </p>
    <div class="course-tags">
      <span class="tag tag-r">R</span>
      <span class="tag tag-eco">Ecology</span>
      <span class="tag tag-fd">Functional diversity</span>
      <span class="tag tag-traits">Traits</span>
    </div>
    <div class="course-arrow">→</div>
  </a>

  <!-- Add future courses below following the same pattern -->

</div>
```
